name: marine_propeller_autonomous
description: Fully autonomous aggressive propeller — the prompt describes geometry + service context only. The agent derives ALL boundary conditions itself (shaft-seat fixture, thrust + torque on the blades) and declares them in spec.load_cases, plus declares the shaft mount (bore + keyway) in spec.features. fem declares NOTHING (use_parent_fallbacks): fem_loadcases verifies the resolved physics of the agent's own load model.

stages.prompt:
Design an AGGRESSIVE 5-blade marine propeller (aluminium) for high volume flow — strong pitch, pronounced skew, wide blade area. Parametric, mm.

Requirements:
- Frame: hub axis along Z, part rests on the XY plane (z = 0), centred in X and Y.
- Envelope: Ø140 overall, height 28 (z = 0..28).
- Shaft mount: concentric Ø10 through-bore along Z with an axial keyway seat (real keyed fit for a Ø10 shaft, not just a plain hole).
- One watertight, valid solid.

Everything else — blade shape, hub proportions, sections, construction method — is your design decision.

SERVICE CONTEXT — derive the structural model yourself: the propeller bolts onto a boat shaft through the keyed bore and spins about +Z under water, producing axial thrust plus drive torque. YOU decide the load cases, fixed supports, load regions/mechanisms and magnitudes — declare them in spec.load_cases. Also declare the machined interfaces (bore, keyway) in spec.features.
